preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) > 100 for _ in [1])])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= A[i] < i+1 for i, A in enumerate(test_case_A)) for test_case_A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array A satisfies 0 <= A[i] < i+1 for all i (0-indexed), meaning A[i] < i+1 where i is the 0-based index corresponding to person i+1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == sum(min(i - depth[i], depth[i]) for i, depth in enumerate(depths)) for line, depths in zip(stdout_text.strip().splitlines(), [compute_depths(A) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum total steps, computed as the sum over each person i (0-indexed) of min(i - depth[i], depth[i]), where depth[i] is the number of people already seated to the left of person i's insertion point.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer string.
